findings.title: Application is debuggable
findings.description: android:debuggable="true" lets anyone with ADB access attach a debugger and read the app's private data with run-as. Release builds should never set it.
findings.recommendation: Confirm this is the release build; remove debuggable from release configuration.
findings.confidence: Definitive for this APK; confirm it is the production build

findings.title: Application data backup is enabled
findings.description: android:allowBackup is absent (defaults to true). From API 31, adb backup excludes app data unless debuggable, but cloud backup and device-to-device transfer still apply.
findings.recommendation: Set allowBackup="false", or define backup rules that exclude tokens and sensitive files.
findings.confidence: Static configuration indicator; confirm with dynamic testing

findings.title: Cleartext traffic permitted for specific domains
findings.description: domain-config entries allow HTTP to the listed domains.
findings.recommendation: Confirm each domain needs HTTP and carries no sensitive data.
findings.confidence: Static configuration indicator; confirm with dynamic testing

findings.title: App trusts user-installed CA certificates
findings.description: A certificate authority installed by the user (or by malware or an MDM profile) can intercept this app's TLS traffic.
findings.recommendation: Trust only system CAs in release builds; move user-CA trust into <debug-overrides>.
findings.confidence: Static configuration indicator; confirm with dynamic testing

findings.title: Exported activity component(s) without permission protection (1)
findings.description: Other apps on the device can invoke these activity components. Review each for sensitive actions or data reachable without authorisation.
findings.recommendation: Set exported="false" where not needed, or require a signature-level permission; validate all incoming intent data.
findings.confidence: Static configuration indicator; confirm with dynamic testing

findings.title: Custom URL schemes registered
findings.description: Any installed app can register the same custom scheme, so links using it can be intercepted. Sensitive data (e.g. OAuth codes) should not travel through custom-scheme links.
findings.recommendation: Prefer verified https App Links for sensitive flows; validate deep-link parameters.
findings.confidence: Static configuration indicator; confirm with dynamic testing

note: Static manifest review only. Exported components and settings are leads for dynamic testing, not confirmed vulnerabilities.
